aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Śrī Śyāma Hari; Bābā, victory to you, Śrī Śyāma Hari. You dwell in Khāṭū Dhām and wear a form beyond compare.
aarti.pad2: You sit on a jewel-studded throne; a whisk is waved above your head. You wear a saffron robe (bāgā), and earrings hang in your ears. ॥1॥
aarti.pad1: A garland of flowers is round your neck, and you wear a crown on your head; incense is cast on the fire, and the lamp's flame burns. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Golden plates are filled with modakas, kheer and cūrmā; your servants offer them to you and serve you every day. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Cymbals, the struck bowl and gongs, conches and the mṛdaṅga resound; devotees sing the āratī and raise cries of victory. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Whoever meditates gains the fruit and is freed from every sorrow; your servants, with their own lips, utter: Śrī Śyāma, Śyāma. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Whoever sings the āratī of Śrī Śyāma Bihārījī — so the devotees say — gains the fruit the heart desires. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Victory to you, Śrī Śyāma Hari; Bābājī, victory to you, Śrī Śyāma Hari. You have fulfilled the wishes of your devotees. ॥7॥
